hints.title: Proper Prefix Matching Suffix Definition
hints.text: A happy prefix is a non-empty prefix that is also a suffix, excluding the entire string itself. What algorithm computes this exact metric at each position?

hints.title: Prefix Function Terminal Value Invariant
hints.text: The prefix-function failure table value at the last character directly equals the length of the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix.

hints.title: Prefix Suffix Table Procedure
hints.text: Compute the array lps for string s using two indices. After iterating through all characters, lps[-1] provides the length of the maximal prefix that matches a suffix. Return s[:lps[-1]].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking prefixes against suffixes naively takes O(N^2) time, triggering time limits for strings up to 100,000 characters.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: KMP prefix table calculation runs strictly in O(N) time with O(N) array storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that this problem is a direct computation of the last value in the KMP longest-prefix-suffix table.
